calls.title: Kim Li and Ashley Stirrup + Scott Keller
calls.summary: Kim Li (Senior Manager, Online Experimentation at Home Depot) discussed pain points with Adobe Target (reliability, SDK maturity, cost) with GrowthBook’s sales team (Scott Keller) and solutions engineer (Logan Bates), who demonstrated their feature flagging and experimentation platform, including AI workflows, visual editor, warehouse-native analytics, and governance controls. Next steps: Kim
